findings.message: Dashboard icon buttons (Help, Start Guide) lack 'aria-label', making them unidentifiable for screen readers.
LoginPage help button is empty and lacks an accessible name.
ErrorBoundary coverage is good across all major route groups in App.tsx.
Ensure all Input components use 'id' linked to 'label[for]' for proper form accessibility.

result.summary: QA & Accessibility Audit completed. Identified several high-priority accessibility gaps and form validation inconsistencies.
